name: Ise Chemicals Corp
summary: ISE Chemicals Corporation, a Japanese company, specializes in the production, refinement, and trading of iodine and its various derivatives, alongside nickel and cobalt compounds. Within Japan, their iodine products are utilized across diverse sectors for purposes such as X-ray contrast media, polarizing films, disinfectants, catalysts, stabilizers, pharmaceuticals, sodium additives, and feed additives. The company's cobalt and nickel compounds serve as essential components in the electronics industry. Furthermore, ISE Chemicals is active in extracting and distributing natural gas to both gas utility providers and industrial clients. Established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1927, the corporation operates as a subsidiary of AGC Inc.
